    The lifted modules and arrows over ℤ/4 (Proposition 10.1) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "Lift the action matrices arbitrarily to free graded 𝒪-modules. […] Equation (prime-field-ext-vanishing) supplies a correction. […] The same bar calculation, using Ext¹, gives uniqueness and lifts all homogeneous maps of nonnegative degree."

    Every evaluated module M_X of A⁽²⁾ lifts to a graded 𝒪P-module on Fin n_X → 𝒪 (exists_modLift), and every arrow map M_y → M_x lifts to a degree-one 𝒪P-linear map between the lifts (exists_arrowLift). These data are bundled in WData.
